title: Add action execute without posting the set

costar.context: Trace timeline does not open the live stream. Action execute is the next remaining portal surface. Creating an x:Action runs the action on the server.
costar.objective: Show the action list and the run confirmation, and do not post x:Action/set.
costar.style: One plan, then the action page.
costar.response: Actions lists the schema variants and asks before running. Execute does not post the set.

concerns: x:Action/set create runs the action. Reload, cache, and queue actions change the running server.
TroubleshootDmarc and ClassifySpam need a nested object. An empty submit is not a valid action.
The route must not import the set call.
context: The schema lists 11 action variants. The page copies are Actions, Run this action?, Execute, Action failed, Action failed., and This field is required. A successful create is created[id]. notCreated is a failure.
current_state: Actions lists the 11 schema variants. Execute shows Action failed and does not post x:Action/set. A variant that needs a nested object says the field is required.
target_design: ActionPanel lists the generated variants. A simple action opens Run this action? and Execute records Action failed without a request. A variant with a schema says the field is required. actionSet builds the create call for the proof only.
changes: Emit the 11 action variants into the catalog.
Render the grouped list and the confirmation dialog.
Keep the route from posting x:Action/set.
boundaries: Do not post a set, a live delivery, or a live action.

verification.name: action-does-not-post
verification.proves: The catalog lists the action variants, the create call has the right shape, and the page does not post it.
verification.result: ok. Browser: Execute on Reload settings shows Action failed, DMARC shows This field is required, and no POST contained x:Action/set.

verification.name: ui-types
verification.proves: The action panel and the route typecheck.
